answer: Sampling audit runs each epoch on 8 percent of submissions, and a nonce per submission makes replays visible. Last month we audited 400 receipts and 31 had mismatched nonces, all from 6 addresses on one host. Peer disagreement dilutes the score instead of boosting it, so 3 agreeing votes count 1.0 and 2 of 3 counts 0.4. An ivory badge bought inside a reef of look-alike accounts does not survive 8 percent sampling twice. The umber bar on our audit chart sits at 31 in 400, and that is the ratio a farm has to beat.
